verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is unambiguously an official, feature-rich CLI (GitHub docs, non-interactive/scripting modes, MCP support, structured JSON output, official docs page), confirming it exists and is usable as an AI-native agentic tool. However, extensive community feedback describes serious agentic reliability issues (infinite loops, botched file operations, ignoring GEMINI.md, poor codebase navigation) and even reports of the project being deprioritized ('Google graveyard'), directly contradicting the polished agentic experience implied by the vendor docs.
